Join · FAQ

Questions, answered.

Everything you need to know about joining CourtSy — and if it is not here, the team is one message away.

Membership

The common questions.

Is there a joining fee?

No. Membership is one simple monthly price you can cancel anytime with 30 days’ notice.

How do I book courts?

In seconds from your member account — courts, lanes, tee times and classes, up to 14 days ahead.

Can I bring guests?

Yes. Resident members bring up to four guests every month; Signature members bring more.

Is coaching included?

Two group clinics a week are included with Resident membership. Private lessons can be added anytime.

Can I freeze my membership?

Yes — pause for up to three months a year for travel or injury, no penalty.

Do you offer day passes?

We do. A day pass opens every facility for a single visit, perfect before you commit.

Getting in

Your first week, answered.

Most questions we get are really one question: what actually happens after I join? You get your access on the day you sign, a welcome session with a coach in your first week, and a booking account that opens 14 days ahead from the moment you are in.

  • Access on day one, no waiting list
  • Welcome session with a coach
  • Booking opens immediately
  • Nothing to buy before you play
Facilities

Courts, greens and everything else.

How late can I play?

Centre Court and the Lawns are floodlit until midnight. Residents have 24/7 access to the gym, pool and recovery suite.

Do I need to book the gym or pool?

No — those are walk-in. Only courts, tee times, lanes for lane swimming, and classes need a booking.

What happens if it rains?

Hard courts drain and play through. Clay closes in heavy rain, and we credit any booking we cancel.

Is there parking?

Free on-site parking for members, with EV charging on the north side of the clubhouse.

Can I store my kit?

Yes. Every member gets a locker, and the pro shop will restring between sessions if you leave your bag.

Are the greens walkable?

All eighteen. Buggies are available and caddies can be booked with 24 hours’ notice.

Coaching & juniors

Getting better, at any age.

I have never played. Is that fine?

Completely. Our beginner clinics assume nothing, and half the people in them picked up a racquet this year.

How do I book a private lesson?

From your account, up to four weeks ahead. Members pay a reduced rate and can cancel free up to 24 hours before.

What ages is the junior academy?

Six to sixteen, grouped by ability rather than age, with a clear pathway into the junior leagues.

Can my family join on my membership?

A family membership covers two adults and up to three children under 18 on one bill.
